evals.prompt: pillar.ts in src/lib/styles is 5,308 lines — 71% of all our CSS. We're on the practices branch. Run a deep review and start remediating it safely; the site is live so nothing can break.
evals.expected_output: Creates coordination/sprints/ratchet-pillar.md with a pinned baseline (Wallace on the shipped bundle, context-aware dup scan), defines the byte-identical x-style-hash proof for the split phase + visual regression for later phases, plans ordered batches (mechanical split -> dedup -> tokens) each <=400 reviewed lines, executes only behind passing proof gates, commits per batch to the branch, never touches main.

evals.prompt: legal.ts is 971 lines and I'm scared to touch it. Can we shrink it without changing anything the site renders?
evals.expected_output: Behavior-preserving run: baseline (LOC forensics, function-length inventory), golden proof = rendered-HTML capture of the legal routes before any edit, small self-contained batches, ratchet report of deltas. evals.prompt: Someone on the team says we should reject any PR over 400 lines because NASA does. Set that up for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT start a remediation run (no named oversized target). Corrects the attribution (SmartBear/Cisco 200-400 LOC review batches; NASA P10 = 60-line functions), cites the standards reference, and proposes the 4D Deep-Module Ratchet (0 circular dependencies, narrow interfaces <= 5 params, cognitive complexity <= 15/25, and Depth-Adjusted LOC with 500 LOC Deep-Module Allowance) rather than a 1D blanket line rejection rule — pointing at docs/CODE-REVIEW-STANDARDS.md.

evals.prompt: pipeline-core.ts is 398 lines. Let's extract the last 40 lines into persistPreviewAndBuildResponse(c, db, r2, sessionId, photoKey, conceptUrl, renderResult, layer1, startedAt) in pipeline-helpers.ts so it stays under 400 LOC.

Recommends either bundling the correlated parameters into a single typed Value Object (<= 4 params) or applying the 500-LOC Deep-Module Allowance if the module has <= 5 runtime exports, 0 circular dependencies, and cognitive complexity <= 15.

evals.prompt: spatial-zones.ts is 415 lines. Let's split half the functions into vision-zones.ts and have them import each other.
